description: KNa₂AlH₆ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten H atoms. There are a spread of K-H bond distances ranging from 2.59-3.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight H atoms. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six H atoms to form NaH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AlH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-27°. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.42 Å. Al is bonded to six H atoms to form AlH₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaH₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-27°. There are a spread of Al-H bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.81 Å. There are six inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Al atom. In the second H site, H is bonded to three Na and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing HNa₃Al tetrahedra. In the third H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, three Na, and one Al atom. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two Na, and one Al atom. In the fifth H site, H is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, three Na, and one Al atom. In the sixth H site, H is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, two Na, and one Al atom.
